question: Is the persistent ARN negative attributable to the LOCAL reducer family, or to the PARENT abstraction that the licensed prose carries recoverable structural correspondence at all?
why_this_is_needed: research/self_rakl_recursive_question_audit_v1/AUDIT_RESULT.json records the ARN lineage as the strongest ancestor challenge on the negative frontier: three distinct repaired reducer families (v2 deterministic, v3 instance-paired, v4 relational) all closed negative against one parent abstraction. The frozen decide() chain selects ASCEND on two failed local repair families, but AncestorChallenge.escalation_admissible is False because no local-vs-parent discriminator is registered. Three failed local repairs establish that the local level is not responsible; they do not separate parent from child. This protocol registers that missing discriminator.

observation_contract.note: The proverb column is NOT an input source: it is the dataset's own key to the intended analogy and reading it would be external completion, not source-grounded acquisition.

instrument.name: contract-bounded separability probe
instrument.logic: The three failed reducers are sophisticated. This probe asks the prior question they all presuppose: under the registered source-grounded contract, does the licensed prose carry ANY label-blind signal that separates the analogue from the distractor? The probe deliberately uses the simplest admissible representations, because it is bounding information availability, not competing on extraction quality.
instrument.task: two-alternative forced choice per corpus row: given query_narrative, pick which of first_choice / second_choice is the analogue

features_frozen.definition: Jaccard overlap of lowercased content-word sets (stopwords removed), query vs candidate
sum of corpus IDF weights over shared content words, normalized by the query's total IDF mass
Jaccard overlap of adjacent content-word bigrams
mean of content-word Jaccard computed separately over the first and last third of each narrative, capturing coarse discourse order

instrument.decision_rule_per_feature: predict the candidate with the higher feature value; ties are recorded and scored as 0.5

split.grouping: by proverb, sorted by sha256(group_key + ':20260814'), matching research/paper2_external_corpus_v1/PROTOCOL.json
split.why: The CONFIRM split belongs to the registered confirmatory epochs. A diagnostic discriminator must not consume it.

null.p_value: one-sided fraction of permuted accuracies >= observed

construct_independence_declaration.note: Declared under the four obligations specified in research/self_rakl_recursive_question_audit_v1/NEG_CLUSTER_CONSTRUCT_DEPENDENCE.md, because a discriminator is itself an instrument.
construct_independence_declaration.CHANNEL_SEPARATION: features are computed from narrative text only; the correct_answer column is never read during feature computation, and the proverb column is excluded from the contract
construct_independence_declaration.AUTHOR_SEPARATION: the gold labels are third-party (the ARN dataset); the features are authored here and were not tuned against the labels
construct_independence_declaration.GOLD_INDEPENDENCE: gold is a property of the dataset, never a function of any feature

frozen_decision_rule.multiple_comparison: Bonferroni over the 4 frozen features (per-feature alpha 0.0025)
frozen_decision_rule.PARENT_RESPONSIBLE_SUPPORTED: no feature exceeds chance at the corrected alpha. The licensed prose carries no label-blind separating signal even for the simplest admissible representations, so the obstruction is above the reducer family and ASCEND is licensed.
frozen_decision_rule.LOCAL_RESPONSIBLE_SUPPORTED: at least one feature exceeds chance at the corrected alpha AND reaches accuracy >= 0.60. The information is present under the contract, so three failed reducers are a local failure and ASCEND is NOT licensed.
frozen_decision_rule.INDETERMINATE__WEAK_SIGNAL: some feature is significant but none reaches 0.60. The discriminator did not separate the levels and is not probative; the ancestor challenge stays inadmissible.

falsifier: A LOCAL_RESPONSIBLE_SUPPORTED outcome refutes the ascent this session recommended. That is the intended failure direction: the discriminator can block the conclusion its author expects.
non_claims: A separating cheap feature does not show that the registered reducers should have found the signal, only that signal exists under the contract.
A null result is not a theorem that prose analogy is unrecoverable; it is bounded by the registered contract, the DEV split and these four representations.
No outcome promotes or retracts any prior ARN terminal. The v2/v3/v4 negatives stand under their own contracts.
This grants no scientific or method-promotion authority.
